title: Tactical Battle Engine — Machine-Readable Rule Schema

rule_id.description: Unique ID, e.g. MV0421, PR0118, TP0301

trigger.description: The specific match event/condition that activates this rule

condition.description: Additional qualifying condition(s), e.g. zone, opponent shape

actor.description: Player role executing the action, references core KB Section 3/51 role names

target.description: Zone or player the action targets, references the 30-zone grid (core KB Section 1.5)

counter.description: How an opponent can neutralize this rule's action
